_comment: Issue #23 canonical: the per-waking dialogue seam's own end-to-end proof, driving THREE shipped consumers live in one continuous run (Selys' board pick added by issue #32's REPEATABLE ruling -- converted from a permanent claimed_board_pick hide_when to this SAME once_per_waking seam, so this script is now its canonical proof too; extend-vs-new call, per wi-writing-qa-scripts: this script's subject is the once_per_waking GATE lifecycle itself, so a new consumer extends here rather than spawning a parallel script). FIXTURE-FIRST (stage3_perks_pre: all three NPCs already at their perk-eligible stage, entity_first_use empty, social_talked pre-set for Erin/Relc/Selys so the run's first interacts open the real hubs directly). Proves, in order: (1) Erin's meal -- the hub option is visible and choosable, banks well_fed + the SAME staged line; (2) the option is GONE on re-open the SAME waking (a fixed-length navigation that used to land on the meal now wraps to a DIFFERENT, known option instead of the meal); (3) Relc's wager -- winning a re-spar (the shipped re-offer status quo, unaffected) then opening the hub pays +1 gold exactly once, with the SAME regression proof the option vanishes for the rest of the waking; (3.5) Selys' board pick -- the newly-repeatable hub option grants +5 gold once, then the exact-length visible-options array proves it's gone the same waking; (4) a real sleep clears well_fed, both once_per_waking banks, and social_talked; (5) ALL THREE are back post-sleep (Erin's re-verified in full incl. a second well_fed grant; Relc's and Selys' re-verified via a second successful payout each, gold climbing 1->6 pre-sleep then 7->12 post-sleep).

steps._comment: == (1) ERIN'S MEAL == social_talked already carries {erin:true}, so this first interact opens the real hub directly. Fixture pins has_package/errand_decided (hides the package row) with cleaned_the_inn/gave_reward/kept_reward unmet and basic_cleaning unknown (hides the cleaning/reward rows), leaving exactly 4 visible options: [0] Just passing through. [1] I heard you play chess. [2] You never talk about where you're from. [3] (Take the seat. The cook has spoken.) -- the new perk option, visible because stage 3 (resolved_wrong_order+chatted_with_erin:4) is met and meal:erin is unused this waking.
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.speaker: Erin
payload_contains.text: Sit. Eat. That's an order, not a suggestion. New recipe — still testing it, but it should stick to your ribs. Call it +2 HP. Don't ask me to explain the math.

steps._comment: erin_meal's options are [Back up a moment.->hub, Thanks, Erin.->end]; default cursor 0 returns to hub.
steps.name: confirm

payload_contains.speaker: Erin
payload_contains.text: Back already? The inn feels almost manageable since you sorted that delivery. Almost.

steps._comment: == (2) OPTION GONE, SAME WAKING == meal:erin is now banked, so the hub shrinks to 3 visible options: [0] Just passing through. [1] chess [2] home. The dialogue panel resets its cursor to 0 on every new node (dialogue_panel.gd's _render_node) and wraps on move (wrapi), so 'move down 3' cycles 0->1->2->0 and lands BACK on 'Just passing through.' (end:true) -- the exact navigation that reached the meal the first time now resolves to a DIFFERENT, ending option, proving the meal option is genuinely gone rather than just reordered.

== (3) RELC'S WAGER == teleport to the floodplains, one cell above Relc (12,13) -- move_player sets player_facing unconditionally before its blocked check, so a single blocked 'move down' onto his occupied cell faces him for real without re-deriving the whole street->floodplains walk this canonical doesn't need to re-prove (relc_tutorial/combat_walkthrough already do).

social_talked already carries {relc:true}: first interact opens the real hub directly. Fixture pins met_relc/sparred_with_relc/given_spear_by_relc (hides the intro/gift rows) with cleared_the_warren+chatted_with_relc:3 (Relc's stage 3), leaving 6 visible options: [0] What's out here worth guarding? [1] Got time to show me how to fight? (Spar) [2] Keep walking. [3] Were you always a guardsman? [4] You ever miss the army? [5] Wasn't that spar worth something? -- the new wager option, visible because stage 3 is met and wager:relc is unused this waking.
